Select distinct IC50 values in nM for compounds tested against Prostaglandin D2 receptor 2 (CHEMBL5071). Return only compounds that have a canonical SMILES and a PubMed ID or DOI. Include compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, activity details (standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment), and target ChEMBL ID, name, and organism. Sort by compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism.
